item.title: Product Data Scientist (Growth) - OpenArt AI
item.description:
**Product Data Scientist (Growth)** **About OpenArt** ------------------------------------------------------
OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future.
### **Why Join OpenArt**
* **Ride an inflection point.** OpenArt has grown **7–10X in revenue over the past 2 years** in one of the hottest categories in tech. Every experiment you run compounds against a steep trajectory. * **Own the experimentation practice** — you'll be the person who defines how OpenArt tests, learns, and ships product changes with real statistical rigor. * **Direct impact on the funnel.** Your work will shape activation, conversion, monetization, and retention for millions of creators. * **Meaningful equity, real upside** at an early-stage company with strong momentum. * **Cross-functional partnership** with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data team. * **Build from 0 1.** Experimentation infrastructure, growth measurement, and retention frameworks are being laid down now — you'll shape them. * High ownership, low process, fast iteration environment.
**About the Role** ------------------
We're looking for a **Product Data Scientist** focused on **growth and retention** to be the analytical partner PMs and engineers rely on when they ship changes to OpenArt's product experience.
This role sits at the intersection of **experimentation, product analytics, and growth strategy**. Your primary job is to turn data into product decisions that move the funnel — activation, conversion, monetization, and retention — through rigorous A/B testing and sharp behavioral insights.
You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth — designing and analyzing experiments across signup, onboarding, activation, paywall/pricing, feature adoption, and retention loops. You'll also do the deep-dive analyses that shape *what* teams decide to build in the first place: funnel diagnostics, cohort behavior, LTV segmentation, and retention driver analysis.
**What You’ll Do** ------------------
### **Experimentation (primary)**
* Design, run, and analyze **A/B tests and other causal experiments** across signup, onboarding, activation, monetization, and retention surfaces. * Set the bar for experimental rigor at OpenArt — help decide test sizing, MDE, run duration, primary/secondary metrics, and readout standards. * Debug and resolve tricky test issues — sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, interaction effects, multiple comparisons, segment heterogeneity. * Build and evolve OpenArt's experimentation practice as we scale — playbooks, guardrails, and post-launch validation.
### **Growth & retention insights**
* Deep-dive analyses on the growth funnel: signup activation paid conversion retention resurrection. * Own retention analysis — identify what drives long-term retention vs. churn, and translate that into product recommendations. * LTV and cohort analyses that shape pricing, packaging, and monetization decisions. * Behavioral segmentation — find the user segments that matter and what drives their behavior. * Opportunity sizing — quantify the potential impact of proposed product changes *before* engineering builds them.
### **Metrics & measurement**
* Define and own key product metrics (activation, engagement, retention, monetization) alongside PMs. * Build and validate dashboards that leaders trust. * Ensure metric definitions stay consistent across product, marketing, and finance.
### **Communication & influence**
* Translate analyses into crisp, opinionated recommendations that PMs, engineers, and execs act on. * Push back with data when a proposed experiment is underpowered, mis-scoped, or measuring the wrong thing.
**What We’re Looking For** --------------------------
### **Core Requirements**
* **3–6 years** of experience in data science or analytics supporting product, growth, or lifecycle teams (level and title flex based on candidate). * **Solid A/B testing depth.** You've designed, run, and analyzed a lot of experiments. * **Strong SQL and Python** — comfortable working with data end-to-end without hand-holding. * **Solid statistical foundation** * **Product intuition and insight-generation instinct** * **Excellent communication** — you can tell a clear data story to a PM, an engineer, or a CPO, and hold your own in a room with strong opinions. * **High ownership and comfort in ambiguity.**
### **Nice to Have**
* Experience as an early hire at a consumer startup. * Experience with consumer products, marketplaces, or subscription businesses. * Experience with experimentation platforms (in-house or vendor: Statsig, Optimizely, etc.). * Familiarity with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests (diff-in-diff, synthetic control, propensity matching, CUPED). * Experience with our stack: BigQuery, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP. * Exposure to AI/ML products or generative AI. * Comfort working across time zones with a globally distributed team.
### **Tech Stack You’ll Work With**
BigQuery, SQL, Python, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP
**Compensation** ----------------
* Competitive base salary and bonus program * Equity — meaningful ownership in what you build * High autonomy, high growth environment
**Work Setup** --------------
* Bay Area preferred (hybrid allowed) * Visa sponsorship available * We’ll consider remote for exceptional candidates

item.title: Data Scientist, Mobile App Performance - PubMatic
item.description:
**About the Role:**
Own the data science function for Mobile App performance, working at the intersection of ML and programmatic advertising. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role-both internally and with our customers.
**What You'll Do:**
**Model Development**
* Build signal enrichment pipelines leveraging contextual signals, behavioral data, and mobile attribution frameworks
* Develop production-grade predictive models based on event data (clicks, installs, in-app events, retention).
* Partner with GTM teams to translate metric frameworks into buyer-facing insights and predictive models
**Drive Product Development**
* Conduct deep-dive analysis to influence product and engineering decisions: pull and query large datasets, extract valuable signals from noise, and produce actionable insights into how we can drive better outcomes for buyers and publishers
* Develop predictive modeling frameworks to quantify performance gains from product hypotheses before they ship — reducing decision latency and de-risking the roadmap
* Act as the senior data science voice in product discussions. Bring partner-level insight and analytical rigor to roadmap decisions.
**Evaluate and Improve System Health**
* Understand changes and drivers across PubMatic's mobile ecosystem: diagnose issues, identify structural inefficiencies, and track input/output metrics at each system component
* Work with product and engineering to define success metrics, design experiments, and evaluate new features before and after launch.
* Design experiment frameworks and causal inference methods that produce reliable, unbiased signals for product and business decisions
**Who You Are:**
**Required**
* 5+ years of hands-on data science experience, with a focus on ML model development, statistical inference, and production-grade analysis
* Deep fluency in Python and SQL; experience with large-scale data environments (Spark, Hadoop, Hive, or equivalent)
* Strong foundation in experimental design, hypothesis testing, regression modeling, and causal inference
* Experience with ML algorithms relevant to ranking, prediction, and optimization problems: gradient boosted trees, deep learning, k-means, and related methods
* Proven ability to extract actionable signals from noisy, high-volume datasets and communicate findings clearly
* Track record of owning projects end-to-end, from problem framing through to production impact
**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience in mobile advertising, programmatic, or ad tech
* Familiarity with mobile measurement and attribution or campaign performance optimization in mobile applications
* Background working alongside ML engineering or product teams on systems where the model is the product
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline
**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
**Benefits:** Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide such as, paid leave programs, paid holidays, healthcare, dental and vision insurance, disability and life insurance, commuter benefits, physical and financial wellness programs, unlimited DTO in the US (that we actually require you to use!), reimbursement for mobile and fully stocked pantries plus in-office catered lunches 5 days per week.
**Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.
